//: Manual on-ramp (design §5, §20.1). The book also teaches Brawling through its martial_art field; this EOC is the awakening.

effect.u_message: The breathing exercises stop hurting and start humming.  You can feel it now: Qi, everywhere, pressing like weather.
Focus the jade slip (a) to meditate.  Eat before long sessions.  Do not cultivate in poisoned places.

//: Fruit on-ramp (design §5, §20.1). Power without control burns; power with control still stains.

then.u_message: A burst of energy floods you, too big to hold.  You feel about to come apart.
At the last second it settles: a faint but powerful beat, deep as a drum.  Your insides are scorched.  Find a manual or teacher before this kills you.

else.u_message: The fruit dissolves into clean fire.  Your dantian drinks deep.
